detail.longDescription: According to the docs : sys. set_lazy_imports ( mode ) Sets the global lazy imports mode. The mode parameter must be one of the following strings: "normal" : Only imports explicitly marked with the lazy keyword are lazy "all" : All top-level imports become potentially lazy However, according to typeshed : _LazyImportMode: TypeAlias = Literal["normal", "all", "none"] if sys.version_info >= (3, 15): def set_lazy_imports(mode: _LazyImportMode) -> None: ... Is "none" a supported mode for sys.set_lazy_imports() ? If so, what does it do? Note 1: "all" does not mean "all imports are lazy"; it means " all imports are potentially lazy", i.e. both lazy import ... and import ... are lazy unless made otherwise by sys.set_lazy_imports_filter() Note 2: I'm not suprised if this is a documentation error, considering lazy imports are still a new feature
